```{python}
#| label: fig-ground-isolation-geometry
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "The opening removes reference material through its full thickness. The signal contact keeps its original position and net. Dimensions are in µm."
import drawsvg as dw

w, h = 920, 400
d = dw.Drawing(w, h)
font = 'DejaVu Sans'
blue, orange, green = '#477ba5', '#c57520', '#298042'
def text(label, x, y, size=16, anchor='middle', color='#202020'):
    d.append(dw.Text(label, size, x=x, y=y, text_anchor=anchor,
                     font_family=font, fill=color))
def line(x1, y1, x2, y2, color='#202020', dash=None):
    d.append(dw.Line(x1, y1, x2, y2, stroke=color, stroke_width=1.4,
                     stroke_dasharray=dash))

text('XY view', 220, 24, 21)
# Source coordinates: domain [-3,3], opening [-1,2], contact [0,1].
scale = 46
px = lambda x: 220 + x * scale
py = lambda y: 190 - y * scale
d.append(dw.Rectangle(px(-3), py(3), 6*scale, 6*scale,
                      fill=blue, stroke='#254764', stroke_width=1.5))
d.append(dw.Rectangle(px(-1), py(2), 3*scale, 3*scale,
                      fill='white', stroke=green, stroke_width=2.5))
d.append(dw.Rectangle(px(0), py(1), scale, scale,
                      fill=orange, stroke='#6c3c0f', stroke_width=1.5))
text('signal', px(.5), py(1)-12, 14)
text('Opening', px(.5), py(-.6), 16, color=green)
text('VSS', px(-2), py(1.8), 18, color='white')
for x in [-3, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3]:
    line(px(x), py(-3)+3, px(x), py(-3)+10)
    text(str(x), px(x), py(-3)+29, 13)
text('x (µm)', px(3)+37, py(-3)+29, 14)
for y in [-3, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3]:
    line(px(-3)-3, py(y), px(-3)-10, py(y))
    text(str(y), px(-3)-18, py(y)+4, 13, 'end')
text('y (µm)', px(-3)-8, py(3)-11, 14, 'end')
line(px(-3), py(.5), px(3), py(.5), '#333333', '5,5')
text('Section at y = 0.5 µm', 220, 389, 15)

text('XZ section through the contact', 680, 24, 21)
x = lambda value: 680 + value * 48
z = lambda value: 220 - value * 310
# Same Z endpoints on both sides; vertical scale is enlarged for visibility.
for left, right in [(-3, -1), (2, 3)]:
    d.append(dw.Rectangle(x(left), z(0), (right-left)*48, .1*310,
                          fill=blue, stroke='#254764', stroke_width=1.5))
d.append(dw.Rectangle(x(0), z(.2), 48, .2*310,
                      fill=orange, stroke='#6c3c0f', stroke_width=1.5))
line(x(-3), z(0), x(3), z(0), '#555555', '5,5')
text('z = 0', x(3)+10, z(0)+5, 15, 'start')
text('0.2', x(-3)-12, z(.2)+5, 14, 'end')
text('−0.1', x(-3)-12, z(-.1)+5, 14, 'end')
text('signal', x(.5), z(.2)-18, 17)
text('VSS', x(-2), z(-.05)+5, 16, color='white')
text('VSS', x(2.5), z(-.05)+5, 14, color='white')
line(x(-1), z(-.1)+20, x(2), z(-.1)+20, green)
for value in [-1,2]:
    line(x(value), z(-.1)+14, x(value), z(-.1)+26, green)
text('Opening: −1 ≤ x ≤ 2', x(.5), z(-.1)+49, 16, color=green)
text('Contact stays at the ground-top height', 680, 354, 15)
text('The opening leaves a lateral gap', 680, 378, 15)
d
```
